text:
Priya Rao: Heads up — handing off oncall. I'm offline from 17:30 UTC for the next 6 hours. Major item: NovaHealth (VIP) has a staged launch & load test tomorrow 02:00 UTC. They requested SLA-level latency during peak. :warning:

Priya Rao: Risk summary:
- Dedicated-west2 pool currently at ~78% commit; autoscaler will spin new nodes but we've not validated the q3 quantized model under peak QPS.
- KV cache cold start could add ~30-70ms p95 on first requests.
- Contract requires 99.9% availability during launch window; AE Sam is on call for customer comms.

Priya Rao: What I did:
- Increased instance reserve for dedicated-west2 by +10% (deployed)
- Pre-warmed sample traffic via staging runner
- Notified infra to hold the maintenance window (ticket #INC-3921)
- Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/novahealth-launch

Josh Kim: I'll take the handoff — will monitor for the next 6h. @Sam Lister can you be reachable for customer pings? :thumbsup:

Sam Lister: Yep, on call for account comms. Share any error snapshots and I'll relay.

Alex Chen: Quick check — which model variant is scheduled? The quantized v3-q8 is the default for cost but v3-bf16 might be safer. If autoscaler spins heterogeneous nodes we may hit perf variability.

Priya Rao: Good call. Prod is v3-q8 by pin. I pushed canary policy to fallback to v3-bf16 after 300ms latency for >5% requests. Details in runbook section "Fallbacks".

Maya Patel: Also FYI: grafana alert "model_inference_latency_p95" is at 250ms baseline for dedicated-west2; I'll add a temporary alert threshold for NovaHealth route to 350ms for launch window to reduce noise.

oncall-bot: Scheduled maintenance flag set for dedicated-west2 from 01:30-03:30 UTC (ticket INC-3921). PagerDuty: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-4827

Josh Kim: Monitoring checklist for me:
- watch grafana dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd/novahealth-prod
- run: `rctl cluster status --cluster dedicated-west2`
- watch redis prefix cache hit: `redis-cli -h cache-west2 GET stats:novahealth:kv:hit_rate`
- escalate to @Alex Chen if p95 > 500ms for 3 consecutive mins

Priya Rao: Also note: if autoscaler fails to add nodes, manual scale cmd is `rctl cluster resize dedicated-west2 --nodes 4` (make sure to check billing lock)

Alex Chen: Acknowledge. I'll be near my laptop during the window, ping me with any anomaly traces. :eyes:

Josh Kim: Good handoff. I'll DM any post-launch notes. Thanks Priya — enjoy time off!

Priya Rao: Thanks all. Leaving logs for you: /var/logs/releases/novahealth-2026-03-16.log
